Prayer is for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner under Section 482 of Bnss, 2023 in criminal
case having Fir No.33 dated 15.02.2017 registered under Sections 406, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471,
120-B of Ipc, Section 13 of Punjab Travel Professionals Regulation Act, 2014 and Section 24 of
Immigration Act at Police Station Navi Bara Dari, District Jalandhar.

2. The petitioner was granted interim bail with direction to join investigation with the police, by this
Court vide order dated 24.09.2024.

3. Today, counsel for the petitioner apprised the Court that in compliance of the aforesaid order, the
petitioner has joined investigation with the police.

Learned State counsel on instructions from Inspector Kamaljit Singh submits that the petitioner, who has joined investigation with the police, is no longer required by the police for the purpose of further investigation.

5. In light of the above, without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is hereby allowed and order of interim bail dated 24.09.2024 is hereby made absolute subject to the conditions as envisaged under Section 482(2) of BNSS, 2023.
